citations.text: Witvliet, Daniel, et al. (2020). Connectomes across development reveal principles of brain maturation. Nature.

description: Directed multigraph of chemical synapses in the L1 larval stage C. elegans (specimen 4). Each synapse is a separate unweighted edge. Multiple synapses create multi-edges. Gap junctions excluded. No autapses.
name: C. elegans L1 Larval Chemical Connectome (Witvliet 2020, Specimen 4)
